request.spec: Let me filter my projects by label.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me filter my projects by label.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes. Let me summarize the change.

I implemented "filter projects by label" as a small, additive, full-stack change:

**Server** — the `tags`/`project_tags` schema already existed (V15), so no migration was needed. I added a new read endpoint that returns the project↔tag attachments in one call:
- `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/tag/ProjectTagLink.java` — view record `{projectId, tagId}`
- `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/tag/ListProjectTagLinks.java` — `service(...)` querying `project_tags`
- `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/project-tags.GET.yml` — exposes it at `GET /api/project-tags`

**Front-end** — `src/main/frontend/features/projects/feature.tsx`: the projects list now loads `/api/tags` and `/api/project-tags`, renders a `data-testid="project-tag-filter"` `<select>` (options keyed by tag id, plus an "All labels" default), and filters the visible rows to projects carrying the chosen tag. Existing `project-row-<id>` and archived behaviour are preserved.

The `bin/e2e` acceptance test passes. No schema migration was required since the tag tables and seed support (`tags`/`projectTags`) were already in place.
